strategies.name: SME Baseline v1
strategies.hypothesis: Price tends to return to the last order block in the direction of the previous session. Entering at the block edge with a stop on the far side pays about 2.3 times the loss when right, and it is right about one time in three.

strategies.name: Donchian breakout
strategies.hypothesis: Price that breaks out of its recent range tends to keep going, so buying new highs and selling new lows with an ATR stop captures trends.

strategies.name: RSI reversion
strategies.hypothesis: After a stretched move the price tends to snap back, so buying a low RSI and selling a high RSI with a time limit and an ATR stop pays on average.
